paper_identity.title: Determination of Y40 and Y60 components in the shapes of rare earth nuclei

theoretical_benchmark.title: Hexadecapole deformation and rotation-particle coupling in the rare earth nuclei

cross_mass_significance: Discovers the fundamental sign reversal of the hexadecapole deformation parameter beta4 across the rare-earth region (from beta4 ~ +0.06 in 154Sm/160Dy to beta4 ~ -0.06 in 186Os/190Os), establishing the microscopic single-particle level restructuring that controls the sharp contrast between rapid backbending in Dy and backbending disappearance/delay in Os-Pt.
